migration_invariants.requirement: The five source MP4 byte sizes and SHA-256 identities remain unchanged. Scale-1A must read them in place and must not rename, rewrite, transcode, or persist media derivatives.
The 94 inventoried Pilot-0 dependency/output files remain the immutable comparison snapshot. Intentional drift requires a path-level report and a new anchor; it must never be silently accepted.

The six family/source-review/asset/interval tuples remain the paired migration cohort. Alternative evidence may be attached only in versioned Scale-1A artifacts; Pilot-0 family semantics remain unchanged.

CLEAN/BLOCKED/RESTORED retain paired budgets, intervention targets, pre-trigger equivalence, deterministic answer-independent triggers, post-trigger route restoration, required reacquisition, and no-trigger controls.

Policy-visible data remains limited to question, tools, budgets, opaque pointers, generic previews, modalities, and source-time intervals; evaluator-private state, family, intervention, answer, claim, support-set, and route identifiers remain hidden.

Citable observations remain bound to hash-verified original media and exact source intervals and are decoded at access time; no persistent media derivative is created without a later explicit authorization.
All current annotations remain machine-adjudicated, provisional, non-human and non-gold. Modality Recall remains null until a separately recorded validation gate exists.
Task-90 metric semantics remain fixed for paired comparison: claim-level Supported-Claim Rate, strict Success@Budget, final-point Premature Stop, eligibility-aware nulls, and LOW_N_DESCRIPTIVE_PILOT.
Pilot-0 aggregates and decisions remain immutable reference values. Scale-1A results use a separate namespace and identify corpus/index/policy versions rather than overwrite Pilot-0 outputs.
Restricted files remain 0600 and effectively protected by a 0700 NOAA parent. Restricted paths, transcripts, predictions, and media identifiers must not leak to public outputs.
If shared implementation changes, legacy Pilot-0 build/run must reproduce the frozen selected outputs; otherwise migration is a declared baseline break requiring review.
The acquisition cohort remains five audited source assets, while the paired MVP cohort remains three assets. These counts must not be conflated.

allowed_scale1a_differences.difference: A separate full-timeline multi-scale index with more windows/records and a new index hash/version.
Additional same-video distractors and alternative support candidates with explicit provenance and counterfactual status.
New visual, speech, ambient, multimodal, or learned retrievers with pinned model/revision/configuration provenance.
Different rankings, retrieved pointers, costs, trajectories, and metrics caused by the full-timeline corpus, provided condition labels and Pilot-0 references are retained.
A versioned backend/tool adapter or shared-code extension that preserves visibility boundaries, C/B/R semantics, and legacy replay.
Later additional families or assets recorded as additions rather than replacements for the paired six-family cohort.
Later human promotion through separately versioned artifacts; this anchor itself remains machine-only and non-gold.
